svg.aria-label: The handbook skill. Boxes: The repository read: its parts, surfaces and capabilities, the tools and the copies (a step of the session); The kinds chosen, each page with its path, each kind left out with its reason (a step of the session); The kinds (stop); Each page drafted from the code and the documentation, each claim's source named (a step of the session); The diagrams drafted and drawn by templates/figures.py in a scratch folder (script); The drafts (stop); The approved drafts written, the diagrams and manual.html built (a step of the session); A command that fails (stop); One commit of every file written (a step of the session); The end: each file, the commit and the commands that rebuild them named (a step of the session).
